individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The college should be improved in developing skills, guidance, management system, etc.

content.Placements: Our batch is of 2014-2018 in B.Tech mechanical engineering. Placements are not much provided in our college because most of the companies are not interested in our college due to recent college performance. During our batch, no mechanical company visited here.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of our college were average, including Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, etc. The quality of facilities was average. The food available in the mess and canteen was good. Medical facilities available are also good, and the quality of sports and games was good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: It is a waste of money as they didn't care for students as much they do about money.

content.Placements: Our college provides a procedure for placement. None of the top companies or firms visit for placement. However, they have placement for all other branches except for the architecture. They have their own center of NATA where they ask students to give exams only if they're going to take admission in the same college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel life was a complete mess including the food. They don't let us go out after 7 in the evening, even on the campus. We were living in jail in a building. No proper facilities were provided for laundry or washroom. They do not allow us to stay in the hostel room while the college hours are on.

individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the college because of placements and crowd, but infrastructure is good.

faqs.question: Does William Carey University have good placements?
faqs.answer: William Carrey University is a private institution established in 1892 in Meghalaya, Shillong. This university in Shillong was established in 2005 by the Government of Meghalaya and named after William Carey, a renowned English Baptist missionary. It is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and accredited by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). The placement of this college has done an excellent job in placing more that 50% of its students every year. Companies like Akash, Byju, Chegg, Havells, Zigram, Physics Wallah, TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, and Mahindra have visited the campus for placements for various posts like research assistant, business analyst, project manager, and subject matter expert. The highest package offered till date has been around 15 Lpa for the post of data scientist and average packages were more than 4 LPA for the profiles like research assistant and subject matter expert. So with WCU you will be in safe hands in terms of excelling and succeeding in your career. At WCU you will be able to work in your dream company.

faqs.question: How are BSc placements at William Carey University?
faqs.answer: The placement cell of William Carey University is fantastic. They train students and invite companies to recruit them. With that the college has achieved a marvelous placement track record over the past several years. Companies like Akash, Byju, Chegg, Havells, Zigram, Physics Wallah, TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, and Mahindra visit the campus for placements. These companies recruit students for various posts like research assistant, business analyst, project manager, and subject matter expert. The highest package offered till date has been around 15 Lpa for the post of data scientist and average packages were more than 4 LPA for the profiles like research assistant and subject matter expert. The institution also provides you with internships and an opportunity for practical work and help you in all-around development. Our college also helps you to have exposure to practical knowledge during your graduation course. You can rest assured knowing that your time in William Carey University will be worth every thing given the mission and vision the college has for all of its students.

faqs.question: Are government jobs offered to BA graduates from William Carey University?
faqs.answer: William Carey University BA graduates can apply for government jobs in their field or another field. For most government jobs, graduation from UGC-approved colleges and William Carey University has UGC approval along with AICTE & PCI. A graduation degree also makes candidates eligible for higher studies, which can help them secure government jobs in teaching, research, and manufacturing. Alumni from the institution have applied and been selected as IPS officers in the state and other parts of the country.

faqs.question: What companies come to William Carey University for placements?
faqs.answer: Top companies from around the world like Mercedes, Toyota, Hyundai, and many more come in for placements at William Carey University. According to IIRF Rankings, in 2023 companies like FSSAI, Chegg, and Havells were the top recruiters during placements. According to Shiksha student reviews, the highest package offered for placements in 2023 was INR 15 LPA and the average package of placements in the university was INR 4 LPA. overview_faqs.question: Does SAU Delhi offer freeships?
overview_faqs.answer: SAU Delhi has a policy with regard to awarding freeships to students from economically weaker families. There are six Freeships with stipend for each Master/ MTech/ BTech programme of SAU. Out of these, three are given to Indian students and three to non-Indian students who have applied for the same and whose annual family income is below the specified amount, which would be determined by the Scholarship/Freeship Award Committee from time to time.

individual_reviews.title: Live your dreams in SAU. Grow with a rapidly growing university.

reviews.review_heading: Live your dreams in SAU. Grow with a rapidly growing university.
reviews.review_text: The university has the best infrastructure and hostels. Centrally air-conditioned academic blocks, classrooms, mess, and TT room. Wi-Fi routers and security cameras are installed on the entire campus. Hostels are perfect with facilities like weekly cleaning, a healthcare centre, sports fields, and a mess. The mess food is way better than the myth about so-called mess food.

reviews.review_heading: South Asian University for B.Teach review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is top-notch. Wi-Fi is available in classrooms, hostels, and almost every part of the college. Hostels are one of the best hostels you can get in government engineering colleges. It also has 24/7 drinking water, hot water for bathing, coffee machines, a playing area, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with faculty.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were excellent. As there were international students in the college. So the environment was very good. There was Wi-Fi campus, digital classrooms, and library with a quality reference book. The hostel was also good. Limited sports facilities were present.

reviews.review_heading: Strong academic foundation with good faculty, diverse opportunities, and solid placement support.
reviews.review_text: Every department has a separate reading room, one common library for all departments, and a common gym. The university provides hostel accommodation for both male and female students. Hostels are equipped with basic facilities such as well-equipped rooms with basic amenities like beds, tables, chairs, and wardrobes. Hostels have access to Wi-Fi for academic and personal use.

reviews.review_heading: South Asian University: Worth it for money.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, labs, and a canteen are well-equipped with Wi-Fi and air conditioners. The food quality of SAU Canteen is one of the best. The hostel is an apartment type. Frequent cleanliness is maintained. The hostel campus has a health center.

reviews.review_heading: If you're selected then please take admission. Better than JNU and DU.
reviews.review_text: There is a fully equipped laboratory. Everyone gets hand on experience with proper guidance and support. All the classroom are equipped with ACs and projectors. There is a fully equipped and adequately spaced auditorium. The library also has the best materials and reading spaces.

reviews.review_heading: Great educational facilities. Medical facilities were great having insurance of up to 1.5 lakh.
reviews.review_text: Have excellent Wi-Fi, great Labs and classrooms with ACs and also a great library. The quality of the food in the mess is way better than the canteen. Hostel had a common room with TV and sofas, fridges and a microwave, and washing machines. Medical facilities were great having insurance of upto 1.5 lacs.

reviews.review_heading: The college has multicultural environment.
reviews.review_text: The permanent campus is under construction, and it is located at Maidangarhi. The temporary campus is located at Chanakyapuri. It is a multi-storey fully air-conditioned building. The college provides the Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are well-equipped, and they use projectors to teach.

reviews.review_heading: South Asian University is best for research work and it is beneficial for those who interested in.
reviews.review_text: South Asian University started its operations from the academic year 2010. The University is currently functioning from Akbar Bhavan, Chankyapuri, New Delhi and 100 acre campus in Maidan Garhi where construction is under way. The campus in Chankyapuri have Wi-Fi, classrooms, Library, medical facilities all are available.

reviews.review_heading: Brilliant Faculty makes SAU an Intellectual Base.
reviews.review_text: It is currently functional in Akbar Bhavan for few year as the new campus in Madan Garhi is in the process of completion. As far as present campus is concerned it is quite spacious and have adequate facilities. It has library, equipped with Wi-Fi, hostel and playground for refreshing your mind, all within the campus. The quality of food available in canteen and mess is quite upto the mark. The proximity with various State Bhavan adds more fun to the variety of food options which is necessary amo...

reviews.review_heading: Now this college is improving day by day.
reviews.review_text: This college has very good infrastructure, air-conditioned in classrooms, a good library, and 2 reading rooms. It is a fully Wi-Fi campus with separate rooms for indoor games, 2 canteens, and 2 messes. The medical facilities are also very good. Every flat contains 1 kitchen for cooking.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of fitness facilities, average mess food quality, and curriculum is good.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi access on the whole campus including hostel. As the university is under construction, the infrastructure of the university is not that good now. But I am sure that after completion of the construction of the university. There will be everything above average. Sports and games facilities are quite good. Medical facilities are not that good for now. Canteen is average, and mess food is also average.

overview_faqs.question: Is Sasurie College of Engineering good?
overview_faqs.answer: Sasurie College of Engineering was established by the Ponmudi Muthusamy Gounder Trust, Tirupur in 2001. The college offers UG and PG courses to students. These courses are provided across the Management, Engineering, Computer Application, and various other streams. The flagship programmes available at this college are B.E./BTech and MBA. The college provides various facilities to students such as sports facilities, library, hostel, and others. The college offers placement assistance to students and is visited by top companies for placements. Hence, it is a good college.

review_summary.college_name: Sasurie College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I loved to be here very much.

content.Placements: Placements are very satisfactory here. No student is left disappointed because the college has a good record in placing all the students. Students get placed in well-reputed organisations like Jaro Education, Amazon, Cognizant, Just Dial, Tech Mahindra, etc. The salary packages offered are spellbound.
content.Infrastructure: The college has all the facilities which an ideal college must have. Students will never get a chance to complain. Sessions by eminent personalities keep happening. They are so motivating in nature. The college is very active in sports that they organize a match of cricket, badminton or kho-kho every weekend.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of "SASURIE COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING". .

content.Placements: Speaking of placements, the placements are reasonably satisfactory at our college. Many reputed companies, such as Cognizant, HCL, Lucid Imaging, Fenestra, and L&T Infotech, visited us in the current academic session, and the college is very committed to molding the students for future interviews and other sessions. To enhance the confidence of the candidates for the future, they conduct interview sessions and other mock sessions.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel offers facilities for boys and girls with large rooms, TV, newspapers, medical checkups, and yoga. A lot of good time was spent in the hostel. We also had many occasions to celebrate in the hostel. The hostel facilities for individual students are comfortable, and the food includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian food that is hygienically prepared with RO water. The students also get to decide what is to be prepared for eating.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Faculty are very friendly.

content.Placements: Placements are pretty good at our college. We had visits from many reputable companies like Cognizant, HCL, Lucid Imaging, Fenestra, L&T Infotech, etc. The college is pretty dedicated to preparing the students for future interviews and other aspects of the selection process. They organize mock interviews and other mock sessions to boost the confidence of the candidates for the future.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels for boys and girls with spacious rooms, television, newspapers, regular medical check-ups, and yoga classes are provided by the hostel. Many memories were made in the hostel. We celebrated many events in the hostel, too. The hostel caters to the needs of individual students with a comfortable stay and nutritious food (vegetarian and non-vegetarian), prepared in hygienic conditions and RO water is served. Students participate in deciding the menu.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: A Degree to add after my name.

content.Placements: While I completed my course, there were no on campus interview opportunity given to us. Not even a single company visited our college. We try our best outside and struggle a lot. Management doesn't care about students. Their only motive is collection of fees.
content.Infrastructure: Though enough buildings are available, maximum are on construction phase. We did our classes in between people involving in construction process. Maintenance of building are also worse. Can you imagine a class there the wall are not finished and shows it skeleton to us.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with infrastructure and teachers but should call more companies for placements.

content.Placements: Around 189 students cored students are placed. The salary offered ranges between Rs. 20,000 per month to Rs. 30,000 per month. An average salary package offered varies from Rs. 12,000 per month to Rs. 30,000 per month. Top recruiting companies of our college are CRI Pumps, TCS, and Sakthi. Roles offered was as supervisors and quality in-charge. Students of our course should score above 6.5 CGPA in their academics to get an internship. Maximum companies are excepting 6.5 CGPA, and some companies expect above 7.5 CGPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a good infrastructure. The college provides facilities such as lab, transport, library, good classrooms, canteen, and hostel facilities. Sports facilities are also provided to students. Good hostel facilities are available, and the food served is also good and hygienic. They also provide Wi-Fi facility.

Candidates who have appeared in Diploma in Engineering and who are awaiting their results can also apply on provisional basis. Candidates should belong to the state of Andhra Pradesh/ Telangana. Candidate should have completed 16 years of age as of 31st December of the year of admission (2023). There is no upper age limit.M.E./M.TechCandidate must have passsed B.E./B.Tech. in relevant stream and obtained at least 50% marks (45% in case of reserved category candidates) from an AICTE/UGC approved institution recognised by the Government of Andhra Pradesh as equivalent thereto. Final year appearing students may also apply on provisional basis.MBA/PGDMCandidate must have completed Bachelor degree of 3/4 years duration with above mentioned marks from any recognised University/Institute. 45% marks for BC categories. Candidate who are appearing for the final year degree examination are also be eligible. Degree obtained by Distance Mode Program should have recognition by Joint Committee of UGC, AICTE and DEC/DEB. Candidate who passed all the subjects of the three years of any Degree course in one sitting is not eligible for admission.After 10th DiplomaCandidates should have passed S.S.C. Examination (Class 10th) conducted by State Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh/ Telangana or any other examination recognised as equivalent thereto by the Board of Secondary Education, A.P/TS. such as CBSE, ICSE, NIOS, A.P. Open School Society (APOSS), X class examination conducted by various State Boards of Secondary Education in India with Mathematics as one of the subjects. Candidates belonging to NIOS/APOSS/Other Examinations recognised as equivalent to SSC by A.P. Govt. should have passed all the subjects including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, with minimum of 35% marks in each subject. Candidates who appeared or are appearing for SSC or equivalent examination being held in April/ May-2023, and whose results are yet to be declared can also apply. There is no age restriction.

The Institute has experienced faculty offering the best education to students. On the basis of Shiksha verified reviews, GVR & S College Of Engineering & Technology has a rating of 3.9 by students. review_summary.college_name: GVR & S College Of Engineering & Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This is the best college for B.Tech and Diploma students, with all branches available.

content.Placements: Our college is offering placements. Almost 80 percent of the students got placed in different countries. The minimum package is 5 LPA-6 LPA. Top roles offered here are software developer, web developer, and VLSI. Top companies like Google, Wipro, and Accenture are offering placements in the college where everyone gets an internship and a stipend.
content.Infrastructure: It is a well-infrastructured college with recent buildings and all the facilities. It has a playground, labs, library, canteen, fully ventilated classrooms, and central AC seminar halls. Laboratories have practical experiments, and libraries have a vast collection of books.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good facilities and our campus atmosphere is friendly.

content.Placements: Around 60% of students are placed. Almost 65% of students get internships. Qualcomm, Intel, Dell, Honey Well, etc., are the best-recruiting companies for our course. The highest salary package offered is 7.6 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3.6 LPA. Top roles offered are associate engineer, system engineer, and quality engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good laboratories, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a library. Our campus atmosphere is friendly. Indoor and outdoor games are also provided. The canteen is available and the food served is delicious. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian foods are available. Our surroundings are clean.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of GVR & S College Of Engineering & Technology.

content.Placements: In our college, the placements are less when compared to other colleges. The placements are less but the package is high when compared to other colleges. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Accenture, etc. Some other companies also visit every year to hire students.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, the laboratories are good to learn, and it contains well-equipped instruments. The laboratories contain good working systems. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. The library contains a large number of books. Our college has a sports ground where students can play various games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of GVR & S College Of Engineering & Technology.

content.Placements: GVR & S College has got excellent placement record, with 100% of the batch getting job offers in reputed organizations last year. GVR & S offers opportunities of interacting with the alumni, regular guest lectures and skill-building workshops than just placements and pre-placement talks.
content.Infrastructure: I am proud to say that the college has a huge library with more than 4000 volumes of books ready for students. The library uses the DDC system for classification and AACR II for Cataloguing. Class numbers are updated as per the need, especially for new growing branches in the subject. Computerization of the library was started in the year 2003-04 and completed in 2006. The library uses SOUL software 2.0.11version. Bar-coding work of all books has been completed before the re-accreditation of NAAC.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am averagely satisfied due to low teaching quality.

content.Placements: About 50% of the students are placed in our course from our college. There are very few companies that hire students. Only a few companies visit our college that too with low salary packages. Very few people get interned by the college. Programmer and analyst are the top roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi portal in our college. Labs are averagely conducted. One has to wait for a long in a few labs due to less equipment. In hostels, hygiene is averagely maintained. Food is somewhat better in mess, good at the canteen with desired rates. Sports are not conducted and there are no grounds.

review_content.Placements: The maximum percentage of students are placed in our course. individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the placements and hostel facilities, but the infrastructure is good.

content.Placements: Nearly 40% of students are placed, with the highest salary being 16 LPA and the least being 4 LPA. Accenture and Infosys are among the top companies, with less than 20% placed in local companies like Accenture. Most students join software companies, and some end up doing work that is irrelevant to their course.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good in the course, but very bad in the hostel. The food served at the hostel is very bad. The washrooms are rarely cleaned, and the premises are a little like a dump yard. The hostel building shakes whenever a heavily loaded vehicle passes by side.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Review of D.N.R College (DNRC, Andhra Pradesh).

content.Placements: About 80% of students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered was 3 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Dr. Reddy's Laboratories and Hetero visit our college to hire students from our course. About 60% of students from our course got an internship. Top roles like quality analysis and quality control are offered to the students.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is also good. Labs are good, and the library is also good. Classrooms are good in our college. The canteen is better for food, and it also serves hygienic food. Sports are most important in the college. It has a huge sports ground and a well-planned sports complex.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Review of D.N.R College (DNRC, Andhra Pradesh).

content.Placements: I passed out from the college in the previous year with a good percentage. Most of the students opt for higher studies. One of our seniors got settled in America. Many engineering students get good placements.
content.Infrastructure: Our college offers good accommodation and a wealthy environment. The hostel is excellent, and the staff is friendly, helpful, and full of local knowledge. They give permission for the outing as well. Labs are cleaned daily, and rooms are spacious. We have huge rooms and good infrastructure.
content.Faculty: We have good faculty members. I enjoyed a lot in science labs. Our college offers many courses like engineering, bachelor's degree for arts and science students. We are proud to be certified by this college with good knowledge about subjects because of our professors.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Review of D.N.R College (DNRC, Andhra Pradesh).

Every student is motivated to participate in social activities such as feeding the poor.
content.Infrastructure: DNR College is established in 5 acres of land, which provides secondary education to higher education like PG course (MBA, MCA and M.Sc). DNR college has 1-acre of playground, gym, sports area etc. DNR College also has an NCC unit. It has a huge library with nearly 1500 books

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Bhimavaram.

content.Placements: I am from 2015-2018 batch. Almost 95% of the students join in our course. The highest salary offered was 1 lac per month, and the lowest salary offered was Rs. 15,000 per month. About 80% of the students got selected in Infosys and Tech Mahindra.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides super well-furnished labs, Wi-Fi facility and CCTV cameras. The college provides hostel facility, and I would rate 75% for food. individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied because of faculty members, training and labs.

content.Placements: Good placements are provided by top MNCs. Around 80% of students got placed in good companies. The training provided is well-appreciated. The way they treat students is good.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available. The food is good. The library is always open to students.Mess is available all the time for food and beverages. The food quality is very good. Medical facilities are good. Doctors are always available.
content.Faculty: Faculty members teach well. They are helpful and knowledgeable. Daily and weekly tests are conducted, which is very helpful for us to gain knowledge. This can be very helpful for the final semester examinations. The notes are very clear.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: An absolutely good place to students who want to become perfect engineers.

content.Placements: Our college provides good placement opportunities for students. Faculty members of the college are keen on improving the placement opportunities and their quality. Many companies like Infosys, Wipro, Hyundai, Renault-Nissan, Ashok Leyland, Tata, Mahindra, Caterpillar, and Larsen & Toubro, etc., visit the college and hire students with good salary packages.
content.Infrastructure: Our College has a good infrastructure. It has a big playground with all the gaming accessories. Our laboratories are equipped with advanced instruments and machines. There are hundreds of computers with all the required software which are up to date. Labs are provided with air-conditioning facilities. The classrooms are good to habitat, and the design of the classrooms, boards and teaching stage is quite amazing. Students are provided with individual table and chair with a drawer below each table. Thus, the infrastructure is not too hi-tech but satisfies all the requirements.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good discipline and well-settled college.

content.Placements: The placements have been done every year throughout all the major companies in India. content.Infrastructure: As our college is near to the Chennai to Bangalore highway, already it is getting an awesome view by the travellers. individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Below-average college experience in the hills.

content.Placements: The students of my batch didn't get placed. I am a 2025 B.Sc. IT pass-out (same as BCA). Neither BCA nor B.Sc. IT had placements. Earlier, till 2017-18, companies like TCS, Wipro, and Capgemini visited, but since then no company has come to campus, so students had to search for off-campus opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Our department is Computer Science, but the classrooms here are in very poor condition. The fans don't work, the lights are not good, and mosquitoes keep roaming around. The Wi-Fi doesn't work either. Electricity often goes out and comes back only after a long time. In the computer lab, the systems are outdated and run very slowly. Since the Wi-Fi doesn't work, we cannot make any proper project. The canteen of the college is below average, and the hostel facilities are very poor. The college is located in the hills, and the nearest market is 5–6 km away. Hostel rates are very high.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Outdated college in every way.

content.Placements: They don’t provide any placement, just eat the fees in the name of training and placement fees, but no company comes. If they come, then it’s a marketing company that is just going to give you 2-3k, which is unacceptable. The computers are also so old they can’t provide you any coding knowledge for the interview.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is very bad. When your semester ends and you get a holiday, after that when the new semester starts, there is so much grass in the college. There are frequent power cuts every time, no Wi-Fi, and if you are able to get Wi-Fi, then there is no speed, you can’t even WhatsApp anyone from that internet. Canteen facilities are also not good; they are just average. The ground is really pathetic, no sports in this college except volleyball, and even that ball flies away.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Faculty is awesome and the view of the campus is beautiful.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placed in my course with a minimum 3 LPA package, and the highest package is 15 LPA. The top recruiters are Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Tata, etc. Almost 80% students got internship and gained market exposure. The top roles after completing BBA is marketing manager sales manager assistant manager, etc. And it also depends on your personal choices, your interests, and all that.
content.Infrastructure: There are big and comfortable classrooms with AC, Wi-Fi and projectors. We have computer labs, 2 big auditoriums and a big canteen that offers us fresh and hygienic food. We also have 2 big libraries for study. And also a medical room for emergencies. We have a big hostel with quality rooms and services like fresh water, gym, sports, clean washrooms, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Overall, I will give 4 stars out of 5 stars, including facilities, placement, and others.

content.Placements: Minimum percent should be 55% with a Science stream, and mathematics is mandatory for BCA. It is a program to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge to pursue careers in software development, database administration, system analysis, web design, and other related fields in the IT industry. And many seniors who have been placed in multinational companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the BCA course typically includes well-equipped computer labs, classrooms with multimedia facilities, a library stocked with relevant books and journals, and recreational areas for students. Additional facilities such as Wi-Fi, projectors, and hostels are often available for students coming from distant places. The quality of food is good, available in the canteen, and we also have sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: There is not much healthy food in the canteen, but the faculty members are good.

content.Placements: I am a BBA student. I have joined this college only two months before, so I don't know much about college. However, I have observed as much as I can. Few companies that visit here for placement drives are Capgemini, Byju's and other third-party companies. But most of the companies are marketing firms. I think the percentage of students who got placed is very low, which is approximately 20%. The salary packages are offered based on the knowledge of students and their performance in interviews.
content.Infrastructure: The only disappointing thing is the infrastructure. Facilities provided are not up to the mark, so I was not satisfied. There are labs. In the library, there are a lot of books for every course. But the internet was not available for students. The food does not meet my expectations. Some limited sports were available and, the background area is not very good for sports. Medical facilities were not available, and I have no experience of the hostel. But there is a friendly culture in IMT.

highlights.summary:
TKWs Institute of Banking and Finance (TKWsIBF), Delhi was established in 2010 by the TKWs Group. Currently, it is run by the TKWs Institute of Banking and Finance Society, which is governed and managed by CMDs and top management of leading banks and financial institutions. This Institute offers diploma courses which are government-recognised and have been accredited by the National Accreditation Board of Education and Training (NABET). Since its inception, it has been awarded as the best institute in the domain of Banking Education and has also received several awards and accolades at different forums in Education and Banking industry.

TKWsIBF offers one UG-level course i.e. Advanced Diploma in Banking and Finance along with Global Post Graduate Diploma in Banking and Finance and a Fellowship Program for working professionals at PG level. The curriculum of these courses is delivered through Experiential Learning Techniques (ELT) keeping a strong industry orientation. The Institute also comprises of a Knowledge Centre and offers IBPS/PO coaching as free add-on classes to PG diploma students, who are keen on finding employment in the government sector.

TKWsIBF also hosts a Bankers Meet, the largest banking event for Banking in India, wherein the influencers and top leaders from the BFSI industry participate to discuss ideas. The Institute also undertakes various research projects on its own as well as in partnership with leading BFSI industry participants. It has also created a special subject called Economic Times which facilitates the students to read business newspapers and stay updated on financial market trends.

Students gain additional exposure through various activities like participating in an annual trading competition set in real market (using Rs 15 lakh as a virtual currency), professional banking communication classes, corporate skills workshops and attending three-day leadership summit organized in collaboration with Rockport Experiential. TKWsIBF best students are also awarded with an Asean Banking Tour of countries like Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, etc.

TKWs Institute of Banking and Finance admission process is open in both online as well as offline modes. Candidates can also apply through the office website of the Institute or offline by obtaining the prospectus from the campus. These include a three-year Advanced Diploma in Banking and Finance at undergraduate level that falls under the category of BCom with Triple Qualifications Program. At PG level, it offers one-year Global Post Graduate Diploma in Banking and Finance which is integrated with three certifications namely Certificate in Investment Banking, Certificate in Business Banking and Certificate in International Trade Finance.

It also offers a Fellowship Program for working professionals of one-year duration. Student clearing these courses also qualify to obtain parallel certifications in CFP, NCFM, Mutual Funds, Credit Appraisal and Trade Finance. review_summary.college_name: Shree H.N.Shukla Group of Colleges Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Review of Shree H.N.Shukla College of Management Studies.

content.Placements: Almost 30 to 40% of the students got placed in our course. The lowest salary offered is Rs. 12,000 per month. The average salary offered is Rs. 20,000 per month. The highest salary offered is Rs. 25,000 per month. The average salary package offered is 2.5 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 3 LPA. This college is very best of job placements. Many companies visit our college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good facilities. Wi-Fi is also available in our college. There is a huge library in college, and all students stay in the library to read books. There are many classrooms in our college. The college offers all course of management. The food served in the college hostel is good. The sports ground is the best in our college. Many facilities are available in our college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The faculty members are friendly and helpful.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are good as many companies visit our campus to offer placements. Our seniors have taken advantage of placements. Around 70% of them were placed, and others got jobs on their own. The lowest stipend offered was Rs. 3,000 per month and the lowest salary offered was Rs. 8,000 per month. Students from the management domain were placed in hotel management companies and airline companies. Around 45%-70% of the students are offered internships. Companies just pay the stipend of Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 4,000 per month. Placements are very useful for the students, and I am very thankful to this college for providing placement opportunities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Everything is good at H.N. Shukla College.

content.Placements: I am a HR manager in a multinational company with 3 years of experience. Our college placed me in this job, and I'm thankful to the college staff. All the staff care about the students. Great jobs and placements are offered, and all students are happy with the jobs. So, we all are thankful for the great job placements.
content.Infrastructure: HNS is one of the top colleges. They provide fully Wi-Fi enabled systems. There are celebrations like Janmastmi, Ganesh Utsav and many more. I would thank the owner of the college Shree Nehalbhai Shukl because he provided this infrastructure suitable for young students' lifestyle and our principal Shree Dr Mehulbhai Rupani for his great support.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2013

content.Other: According to study purpose this is the best college in Rajkot. HNS has an approximately 3000 students. & the management of the collage is too good. Shukla collage is the best collage they provide many courses like b.com, M.com,MBA,llb,MSW & many more.There is a good educational environment in that campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The best college I've seen.

content.Placements: 45% of students have come to the pharmacy in our college. A minimum package is 1.5 LPA. The maximum package is 6 LPA. Salary job opportunities occur at Sun Pharma, Torrent, and J.B. Chemical. Around 30% go into internships. I'm currently an intern at ABC Medical Store as a Pharmacist Assistant.
content.Infrastructure: In my college, Wi-Fi is available, AC is available, and currently, some classrooms are under renovation. The food in the mess is the best, and in sports, it’s like a career. A sports academy also exists in my college, and chess, volleyball, and football competitions are held regularly by the college.

Dr. Preeti Global University course admissions are done based on entrance and merit depending on the course. The university accepts applications in offline mode only. Interested students can get theDr. Preeti Global Universityapplication form from the university campus. The form has to be submitted along with specified documents.
Students can pursue UG, PG, After 10th and Certificate programmes in fields of Engineering, Medicine and Health Sciences, Business and Management Studies, IT and Software, Accounting and Commerce, Mass Communication and Media, Law, Humanities and Social Sciences, Hospitality and Travel, Science, Teaching and Education and Nursing, and more. To know about the eligibility of Dr. Preeti Global University courses, students can visit the website.

Dr. Preeti Global University fee structure consists of caution deposit, exam fee, hostel fee, and more. The mode of payment for Dr. Preeti Global University fees is online. Interested candidates can check below for more details on Dr. Preeti Global University admission:

faqs.question: Can I start a law practice without a Law degree or become a lawyer?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. To become a lawyer, one must first complete three-year or five-year LLB from a recognised university and possess degree certificate. Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

faqs.answer: Admission to Shri Vishnu Engineering College for Women (SVECW) is done through EAMCET counseling or by enrolling with the college. Candidates must perform well in Andhra Pradesh EAMCET and score as equivalent to the SVECW's B Tech cut-off norms.Other ways to join SVECW include:Buying a seat through management quota or NRI seat directlyCompleting an undergraduate degree with 50% aggregateCompleting the VU Entrance Examination or UCEEDSVECW has over 800 seats and offers 12 courses across 3 streams.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to Shri Vishnu Engineering College for Women with 60% in Class 12th?

individual_reviews.title: Friendly faculty members with awesome skills.

content.Placements: 90 percent of B.Tech ai&this students are placed in our college.
